examShortTricks: Trick 1: E°cell = E°cathode − E°anode (reduction potentials, no multiplication by stoichiometry) — the 'no multiplication' note is the classic 1-mark trap.
Trick 2: Higher reduction potential = better oxidising agent = cathode; SHE is the zero reference — order species by E° to predict feasibility.
Trick 3: Spontaneity: E°cell > 0 → ΔG° = −nFE°cell < 0 — the thermodynamic link earns the extra mark.
Trick 4: EMF is an INTENSIVE property (independent of amount); n and E° combine only inside ΔG.
